title: Generic lissity of a constructible Weil sheaf over its finite-field model
statement: Fix a finite field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, and $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with the datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X_0$ be a reduced separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $(F,\theta)$ be a constructible $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-Weil sheaf on $X_0$ in the common-stage constructible-heart convention [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Thus $\theta:\Phi_X^*F\xrightarrow{\sim}F$, for geometric Galois Frobenius $\Phi_X$. There is a dense open subscheme $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ such that $j^*F$ on $U=U_0\times_{k_0}k$ is lisse in the adic sense [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. The restricted Frobenius isomorphism makes this restriction a lisse Weil sheaf on $U_0$. The empty scheme is included, with $U_0=X_0$.

source.place: Proof paragraphs 1 and 4, generic lissity and finite-field-model choice; Deligne, Weil II (1.1.1), pp.146-147 supplies the constructible/lisse adic conventions.
